top_impact_decisions.title: Pass Councillor's Bill No. 22, with conditions, on second reading for the Comprehensive Plan Amendment for Mandalay Gardens, Tract 10, Lot 2
top_impact_decisions.plain_summary: The council approved the second reading of Bill No. 22, which will amend the Comprehensive Plan for Mandalay Gardens.

top_impact_decisions.title: Pass Councillor’s Bill No. 52 on first reading to approve the Petitions for Inclusion in the Foster Farm Business Improvement District
top_impact_decisions.plain_summary: The motion to approve the Petitions for Inclusion in the Foster Farm Business Improvement District was approved by a majority vote.

top_impact_decisions.title: Pass Councillor’s Bill No. 53 on first reading to execute three separate one-year leases, renewable automatically on an annual basis for four additional one-year terms, for one single-family home, one trailer pad/mobile home site, and one agricultural lease at the City's Strasburg Natural Resources Farm
top_impact_decisions.plain_summary: The motion to execute the leases for housing and development was approved by a majority vote.

top_impact_decisions.title: Approve Councillor’s Bill No. 22 on first reading for the Comp Plan Amendment for Mandalay Gardens, Tract 10, Lot 2, to change the current land use designation from Commercial to Service Commercial with condition of the location of the building and the condition of the signage of freight traffic.
top_impact_decisions.plain_summary: The motion to approve the land use designation change for Mandalay Gardens was passed with some conditions.

top_impact_decisions.title: Pass Councillor’s Bill No. 28 on first reading, adding Section 20 to Chapter 1 of Title X to the Westminster Municipal Code to provide for traffic regulation through the use of automated vehicle identifications systems conditioned on the use of the funds going toward traffic safety.
top_impact_decisions.plain_summary: The motion to approve the bill for traffic regulation was passed with some conditions.

top_impact_decisions.title: Pass Councillor’s Bill No. 54 on first reading to amend Title 5, Chapter 7; Title 8, Chapter 1; and to add Title 8, Chapter 14 of the Westminster Municipal Code concerning recycling, compost, and plastic regulations
top_impact_decisions.plain_summary: The motion to amend the recycling, compost, and plastic regulations was approved by a majority vote.
